scope.title: Slim the spec entry and prevent doc ossification

decision.reason: Every task spec now carries a lifecycleStatus (check-spec-lifecycle PASS 518/518); a single doc-gardening rule names its executable check; policy-docs (10) and error-governance (16) checks PASS; AGENTS.md stays a <=400-line routing entry. Retirement is by archived status, never mechanical deletion.

gardening.rule: harness/specs/rules/spec-doc-gardening-boundary.md (single doc-gardening rule naming its executable check)
gardening.agentsEntry: AGENTS.md stays a <=400-line routing entry pointing at harness/specs/**

specLifecycle.result: lifecycle status present for 518 task specs

residual.noDeletion: No spec or doc is auto-deleted; retirement is explicit archived status reviewed by diff.
residual.agentsGrowth: If AGENTS.md ever exceeds 400 lines, rules must be demoted into harness/specs/** (the rule records this).

independentVerification.detail: The G02 test scans every task spec for a valid lifecycleStatus, checks the AGENTS.md size/routing, and asserts a single doc-gardening rule naming its executable check; the existing lifecycle/policy/error-governance checks re-run against the tree. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: All 518 task specs carry a valid lifecycleStatus; the 17 previously-missing (including this program's packets) were fixed.
Retirement is by archived status; no spec or doc is mechanically deleted and product/rule/source retention is unchanged.
AGENTS.md is <=400 lines and routes to harness/specs/** as the durable policy home.
Exactly one doc-gardening rule exists and it names its executable check (check-spec-lifecycle.mjs); no parallel source of truth.
3 tests pass, lifecycle/policy/error-governance checks pass, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: Long-term doc staleness trend over real calendar time.
A separate second-agent independent verifier role.
